profile.headline: Software Engineer at Mistral AI | Ex-Meta
profile.summary: I’m a software engineer with a strong interest in developer productivity tools. Compilers, programming languages, IDE tooling, anything to improve the lives of software engineers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
HHVM - runtime for the Hack language. I worked on performance wins for developer environments, including memory pressure for copy-on-write types. Wrote a series of AI-enabled tools like agentic debugging via the REPL. 

Previously:
* Worked on the Hack typechecker. System performance, distributed type checking, IDE experience and all things reliability.

* Implemented messaging reliability metrics for Android Messenger, creating insight into the latency and reliablity of billions of message sends per day.

positions.title: Tech Founder
positions.description:
* Built a web application to securely store your cell phone contacts which are accessible via SMS
* Designed and built an iPhone application in Objective-C to access your cell phone contacts and bulk upload them to the web servers, allowing users to quickly get full use of the service.

positions.title: Junior Web Engineer
positions.description:
* Helped build a large application that collected survey data from the Universum survey and pushed 
asynchronously via IronMQ to Amazon S3 and displayed custom feedback to students
* Responsible for setting up the initial version of a standardized server provisioning system with Chef 
and custom recipes 
* Created the digital version of the Universum Top100 product with a multitenant application 
leveraging PostgreSQL schemas as databases and Redis-backed translations for localization.

positions.title: Student
positions.description:
-Studied multiple technologies, including Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Javascript, Git, and others.

- Co-created Openexam.org, a collaborative quiz tool for students to interact with instructors and insightfully ask questions for quiz material.

- Designed a Chrome extension in JavaScript to allow users who passively browse the internet to be alerted of relevant deals and discounts.

positions.title: Alumni Advisory Board Member
positions.description: I serve as a member of the 2012 Alumni Advisory Board where I contribute to shaping the future of Lean Startup Machine. I focus on obtaining product sponsorships for our workshop attendees.

positions.title: Intern, Business and Corporate Development
positions.description:
Worked directly under the head of business and corporate development on mobile application acquisition. 

Was in charge of monitoring the Android and iOS ecosystems daily to track rankings of popular games. Generated leads for potential acquisition targets.

Valued mobile applications on a multiples basis to determine fair prices for games that would fit within the MyYearbook brand.
